Your work will make secure access simpler and more reliable, helping advance 1Password’s mission to create a safer, simpler digital future for everyone. 

  How we’re using AI today  
 Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security.  • Bring substantial experience in a technical IT role, including experience in IT engineering or systems administration. 
 • Administer Okta or a comparable Identity Provider (IdP), such as Microsoft Entra ID, in a production environment.

 • Bring experience managing an IdP with Terraform, using 1Password Enterprise and Device Trust, or supporting Service Organization Control 2 (SOC 2), Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), or ISO 27001 audits. 

  What you can expect:  
 • Operate and improve Okta, including tenant configuration, policies, lifecycle management, and complex identity issues. 
 • Lead IAM initiatives from concept through rollout, including role-based access control, access reviews, and onboarding and offboarding automation. 
 • Build safeguards that make identity and access changes safer to deploy and easier to audit.
